takes.title: Run Forward with Bent-Arm Swing
takes.actionDescription: After four arms-out frames, the performer runs forward with bent elbows and alternating strides. The source jumps into the run, which ends mid-stride.
takes.reviewNote: Captured frames 1–4 have all-zero channels. Frame 5 (0.0333 s) is the first moving pose and follows a 1.609 m horizontal root discontinuity. The first usable frame is recorded for later review.

takes.title: Walking in multiple directions
